mapper.sql: strategy_id::text AS strategy_id, user_id::text AS user_id, account_id, name, symbol, side, trigger_price, quantity, max_spend, max_position, max_orders, max_failures, dry_run, status, orders_placed, consecutive_failures, last_price, expires_at, created_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO strategies (user_id, account_id, name, symbol, side, trigger_price, quantity, max_spend, max_position, max_orders, max_failures, dry_run, expires_at) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{accountId}, #{name}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{triggerPrice}, #{quantity}, #{maxSpend,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{maxPosition,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{maxOrders}, #{maxFailures}, #{dryRun}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) RETURNING strategy_id::text
SELECT FROM strategies WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid)
SELECT FROM strategies WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE strategies SET status = 'ENABLED', consecutive_failures = 0, last_price = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status IN ('DISABLED', 'TRIPPED') AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
UPDATE strategies SET status = 'DISABLED', updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ENABLED'

UPDATE strategies SET orders_placed = orders_placed + 1, last_price = #{price}, updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ENABLED' AND orders_placed < max_orders AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
UPDATE strategies SET orders_placed = GREATEST(orders_placed - 1, 0), updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid)
UPDATE strategies SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ENABLED' AND orders_placed >= max_orders
UPDATE strategies SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ENABLED'
UPDATE strategies SET last_price = #{price} WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid)

UPDATE strategies SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, status = CASE WHEN status = 'ENABLED' AND consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_failures THEN 'TRIPPED' ELSE status END, updated_at = now() WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid)
UPDATE strategies SET consecutive_failures = 0 WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND consecutive_failures <> 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_events (strategy_id, kind, detail) VALUES (CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid), #{kind}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT occurred_at, kind, detail FROM strategy_events WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity * limit_price * (1 + fee_rate)), 0) FROM Orders WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND side = 'BUY'::order_side_enum AND status IN ('NEW'::order_status_enum, 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'::order_status_enum, 'FILLED'::order_status_enum)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity - o.filled_quantity), 0) FROM Orders o JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND i.ticker = #{symbol} AND o.side = #{side}::order_side_enum AND o.status IN ('NEW'::order_status_enum, 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'::order_status_enum)
mapper.update: UPDATE Orders SET strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.select: SELECT strategy_id::text FROM Orders WHERE order_id = CAST(#{orderId} AS uuid)
SELECT order_id::text FROM Orders WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND status IN ('NEW'::order_status_enum, 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'::order_status_enum)
